applyTo: "react/**"

# React Instructions

## React

- Use functional components.
- Use React hooks rather than class components.
- Follow existing component patterns.
- Keep components small and focused.
- Prefer composition over complex component inheritance.

## TypeScript

- Use explicit types where they improve readability.
- Avoid `any`.
- Reuse existing types and interfaces where possible.

## Testing

- Follow the existing frontend testing conventions.
- Test user-visible behaviour rather than implementation details.

## Accessibility

- Use semantic HTML.
- Ensure interactive elements are keyboard accessible.
- Maintain existing accessibility standards.
